map.→ 打开转化漏斗分析工具: -> Open the conversion funnel analysis tool
map.举例：访问 10000 → 加购 3000 → 下单 1200 → 支付 800: Example: 10000 visits -> 3000 add to cart -> 1200 orders -> 800 payments
map.优先看「绝对流失人数」与「相对流失率」双重指标。本例中访问→加购流失 7000: Look at both the absolute loss count and the relative loss rate. In this example the visit-to-cart loss is 7000 people (70%), the largest by magnitude; although the order-to-payment loss rate is only 33%, the payment step has a high ticket, so both should be scheduled and the largest bottleneck tackled first.
map.做渠道质量对比：不同来源流量进同一漏斗，比较各渠道在关键步骤的留存差异。: Compare channel quality: run traffic from different sources through the same funnel and compare the retention difference at each key step.
map.哪一步最该优先优化？: Which step should I optimize first?
map.定位转化瓶颈：录入访问→加购→下单→支付各阶段人数，计算每步转化率与流失率，找出: Locate the conversion bottleneck: enter the visitor counts for visit -> cart -> order -> payment, compute the conversion and loss rate of each step and find where the biggest drop is.
map.录入营销各阶段（访问、加购、下单、支付）的客流量，工具计算每步转化率与流失率并可: Enter the traffic at each marketing stage (visit, cart, order, payment); the tool computes the conversion and loss rate of each step and visualizes the funnel to locate the bottleneck, helping optimize traffic and pages.
map.用同一口径的时间窗或同批流量做 A/B 对比，避免季节性干扰；关注「相对转化率」: Use the same time window convention or the same traffic batch for A/B comparison to avoid seasonal interference; watch the relative conversion rate rather than absolute counts so a shift in traffic mix does not mislead.
map.评估运营改动效果：上线新页面或新活动后，对比前后各步转化率，量化提升。: Evaluate the effect of an operations change: after a new page or campaign launches, compare the conversion rate at each step before and after to quantify the lift.
map.：加购率 = 3000/10000 = 30.00%；下单率 = 1200/30:
: add-to-cart rate = 3000/10000 = 30.00%; order rate = 1200/3000 = 40.00%; payment rate = 800/1200 = 66.67%.
Overall conversion = payments/visits = 800/10000 = 8.0%. The biggest loss is "visit to cart" (70% lost), so optimize the landing page and the above-the-fold hook first.
